CustomField.label: Account
CustomField.description:
★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.COMP_SEQ, which pointed at SEIM_COMP. The business chose to reuse Account rather than add a company object, so this is that pointer.
Resolved once, at add time, by following Event_Attendee__r.Contact__r.AccountId — the customer this guest belongs to is derived from the Contact link and never guessed from the company text. An attendee who is not linked to a Contact has no Account here, and that is a real and expected state, not a data error: it is the professor, the journalist, the guest who is nobody's customer. What follows from it is Open Question 21 — such a row has no Cust_Cd__c and therefore no chain to route to once R7 is built.
SetNull, never Restrict: an invitee row must never be able to block the org from deleting its own Account. Nothing here writes to Account, and nothing dereferences this lookup after the snapshot is taken — Invitee_Org__c and Cust_Cd__c hold the values, so a report can show them without the reader needing any grant on Account.
